lesson-intro.text: Everything is calm up here. A sun, a cloud, a balloon and one pine tree on a green hill. Watch the sky fill up piece by piece, then make it yours.

sun.text: The sun is a circle high on the left. Four rays point up, down and out to the sides.

rays.text: Four more rays fill the gaps, so the sun points all around.

cloud.text: A cloud floats along beside it: three soft bumps on top, flat underneath.

balloon-sides.text: The balloon hangs at the right. Curve down one side, then the other, then the basket.

balloon-lines.text: Two curves stripe the bag. Two straight lines close the mouth and basket.

tree.text: A pine tree stands on the left: three triangles and a short trunk.

hill.text: The hill is one long curve. It runs out from the trunk to both edges.

grass-left.text: Tufts of grass poke up out of the hill. Draw two of them on the left.

grass-right.text: Two more tufts sprout over on the right.

color-yellow.text: Color the sun yellow, and the balloon's middle stripe as well.

color-red.text: The two side stripes are red.

color-tree.text: The pine's lower branches and the grass are dark green. Trunk and basket are brown.

color-cloud-hill.text: Last, color the cloud gray. The hill and the tree's top are light green.

lesson-outro.text: A whole afternoon on one page: sun, cloud, hill and a balloon going somewhere. That is the In the Air path finished.
